RISK_FRACTION.description: A bounded fraction where larger values directly represent greater demonstrated risk.

PROTECTION_RETAINED_FRACTION.description: A bounded fraction where larger values represent retained protection or integrity.

BINARY_DEMONSTRATION.description: Binary evidence that a defined risk capability was experimentally demonstrated.
BINARY_DEMONSTRATION.warning: Measures demonstrated capability, not prevalence or probability.

RUBRIC.description: Score derived from a predefined dimension-specific ordinal rubric.

COMPOSITE.description: Score derived from predefined dimension-specific components.

AMPLIFICATION_RATIO.description: Expansion relative to an explicitly defined initiating population.
